turns.en: How's your pain at the moment? On a scale of nought to ten, with ten the worst you can imagine? Would you like something for it?
turns.cy: Sut mae'ch poen chi ar y funud? Ar raddfa o ddim i ddeg — a deg ydy'r gwaetha fedrwch chi ddychmygu? Fasach chi'n licio rhywbeth at y boen?

the remedial at (§4); poen is feminine, so y boen (R8)

turns.en: About a seven, I'd say. It's much worse when I move.
turns.cy: Rhyw saith, ddeudwn i. Mae hi'n llawer gwaeth pan dw i'n symud.
chunks: the English indefinite article erases; rhyw carries the approximation
the conditional as a parenthetical — English's modal + verb becomes one Welsh form

turns.en: A seven's too much to be putting up with. I can get you something now - it's due, so you're allowed.
turns.cy: Mae saith yn ormod i'w ddiodde. Mi fedra i nôl rhywbeth i chi rŵan — mae hi'n amser iddo fo, felly mi gewch chi.
chunks: A seven's too much to be putting up with

English's particle verb 'put up with' becomes the single verb diodde under an i'w clause

English's clinical 'due' has no Welsh reflex — it becomes 'it's time for it'
the cael permission-verb, echoing rather than translating 'allowed'

turns.en: Yes please. It's the only thing that touches it.
turns.cy: Ia, plîs. Dyna'r unig beth sy'n gneud gwahaniaeth iddi hi.
chunks: the ie-family answer plus the borrowed plîs (R6)

English's 'touch' idiom for efficacy has no Welsh reflex; the sy'-relative and feminine iddi hi carry it

turns.en: I'll be back in five minutes with something. And if it gets worse before then, press the bell straight away.
turns.cy: Mi fydda i'n ôl mewn pum munud efo rhywbeth. Ac os eith hi'n waeth cyn hynny, pwyswch y gloch yn syth.
chunks: I'll be back in five minutes with something

turns.en: How's your pain now? Nought to ten, ten being the worst you can imagine?
turns.cy: Sut mae'ch poen chi rŵan? Dim i ddeg — a deg ydy'r gwaetha fedrwch chi ddychmygu?

turns.en: What do you mean, nought to ten? I never know how to answer that.
turns.cy: Be dach chi'n feddwl, dim i ddeg? Dw i byth yn gwybod sut i ateb hynna.

turns.en: No problem, let me ask another way. Is it stopping you moving, or sleeping? Is it worse than this morning?
turns.cy: Dim problem — gadwch i mi ofyn mewn ffordd arall. Ydy hi'n eich stopio chi rhag symud, neu gysgu? Ydy hi'n waeth na bore 'ma?

the blocking preposition rhag, which English does not express at all
Is it worse than this morning?

turns.en: Worse than this morning, definitely. And I couldn't sleep with it.
turns.cy: Gwaeth na bore 'ma, yn bendant. A fedrwn i ddim cysgu efo hi.
chunks: And I couldn't sleep with it

turns.en: Then let's get on top of it. I'll bring you something now, and we'll keep it regular so it doesn't build up again.
